title: Article. Investing is Just Answering a Series of Questions: Explaining the Reverse DCF
summary:
A valuation is a means by which you whittle down those questions to the most relevant and then attempt to answer them. Despite what you might recall from an academic textbook, there is ultimately only one valuation framework. Now, there is different
implementations of how to value a business, but all true valuation methods come back to
that same idea that Buffett espoused above.
